artifact.title: Hiring trends in India

bf8b6904-1f8e-51d9-b29f-5d370e6c009e.content_text: Hiring trends in India, 2026 edition. The survey covered 4,200 employers across 12 sectors. Median time to hire fell to 31 days, down from 38 weeks a year earlier. 27% of employers said they now use structured interviews for every role. Remote roles made up 18% of postings. Employers reported 2.3 million open roles nationally.
